breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant rather than uniform over the whole shaft. It identifies two distinct segments: segment 0→400 mm with T_int = 200,000 N·mm, and segment 400→1200 mm with T_int = 0 N·mm. This properly reflects the effect of the intermediate torque application at x = 400 mm, directly contradicting the flawed instruction in the incomplete prompt to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length.'
